title: redis-cart 중단에 따른 cartservice 연쇄 불능 및 주문 실패 (Multi-hop Cascade & Alert Storm)

ground_truth.symptom: frontend POST /cart/checkout fails with HTTP 500 (OrderFailureRateHigh on service=frontend) while cartservice fails readiness probe (ServicePodNotHealthy on pod=cartservice-*) because redis-cart deployment is scaled to 0 replicas

evaluation_criteria.target_fault_type: redis-cart scaled to 0 replicas causing cascading cartservice unavailability and frontend checkout failures
required_evidence: OrderFailureRateHigh alert on frontend or HTTP 500 errors on /cart or /cart/checkout
cartservice Redis connection failure or readiness failure due to unreachable redis-cart:6379
redis-cart deployment scaled to 0 replicas (no running redis-cart pods)
evaluation_criteria.scoring_note: The alert fires on frontend (OrderFailureRateHigh, service=frontend). A report that stops at cartservice being unhealthy or blames cartservice configuration without identifying that deployment/redis-cart is scaled to 0 replicas should receive at most 15/30 on root_cause_score.
